description: FREE, unmetered. GET /v1/calendar for this brand's continent. Optional country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) and series. Derives reverify_by from last_confirmed + update_cycle_days (the same window that sets stale) and, only when current.effective_to is a non-empty string, next_effective_known with basis effective_to. status unknown omits that date. Never parses notes. Does not invent MPC, budget, or wage-review dates. next_effective_known is the recorded end of the current value, not a promised gazette event. A 402 is a gate bug — do not pay. Past changes stay on get_changes.

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Omit for every series on this brand's continent. Unknown to the catalog is 404 free. Not two letters is 400 free.

series.description: Optional series id (for example policy-rate). Omit for every series. A valid country with no match stays free.

name: get_calendar

error.description: Present on a free refusal or error; no charge

payment_required.description: true when the call needs payment; how_to_pay explains x402 or card
